about: The redirect's deflect (milestone-1 task 90), made in Cascadeur: the bare-handed parrier's half of the redirect's one pair, played for every redirected attack from its contact frame (3). From bare hands' guard (the Jab's frame 0, held), the lead (left) hand reaches out and meets the attacker's right wrist on frame 3, where Right Cut's is on its contact frame at Right Cut's pair distance (1.47 m, task 34's deflect's), and sweeps it on across to the right by 9 as both feet step 0.2 m in and 0.2 m off the line to the left, out of the blade's way; then the hand comes back and the feet step back into the guard by 24. The hips go with the feet (no travel: the rules hold the parrier still). Cascadeur's AI inbetweening generates every frame but the key poses. Picture only. Source frames at 30 fps from 0.
